measures.title: Erie County – Proposed Tax Levy (Renewal): Addiction and Mental Health Services
measures.summary: Asks whether Erie County may renew a property tax of up to 0.7 mill for 10 years, beginning in 2027 and first due in 2028. The money pays for community addiction and mental health services providers and for acquiring, building, renovating, financing, maintaining and operating alcohol and drug addiction and mental health facilities. The county auditor estimates it will collect $1,555,645 a year, or $15 for each $100,000 of the auditor's market value.
measures.yesMeans: The 0.7-mill addiction and mental health levy is renewed for 10 years.

measures.title: Erie County General Health District – Proposed Tax Levy (Renewal)
measures.summary: Asks whether to renew a property tax of up to 0.2 mill for 5 years, beginning in 2027 and first due in 2028, to fund the health program of the Erie County General Health District's Board of Health. The county auditor estimates it will collect $504,712 a year, or $5 for each $100,000 of the auditor's market value.
measures.yesMeans: The 0.2-mill health district levy is renewed for 5 years.
